rail

layout · 0.1.0 · A3 · aj-l-rail

The spiral binding down the paper's left edge. Decorative, aria-hidden, no tap area, never navigation; every screen. Positioned in the shell and welded to the page: at tablet it follows the centred page, at desktop it sits at the title block's edge (--title-w), on iOS it stops at the tab bar.
